metadata.description: Design, motion, creative-direction and design-council skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: design-director
plugins.description: Art-direct and build distinctive UI for React/Next.js + Tailwind: audits, creative direction, design tokens, motion systems, modern CSS, creative/3D effects, full RTL/LTR support, and screenshot-based visual verification.

plugins.name: design-council
plugins.description: A council of design experts that examines a project's current state and decides its design & experience direction: what fits this stage, the next three moves, and what not to do now. Decisions are recorded in the repo.
